analytics.name: Analytic 1874
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol write to a controller's task/organization-block configuration from a source not in the approved engineering workstation list, correlated against post-modification cycle timing deviation. Documented precedent: Stuxnet infected Siemens OB1 (main execution cycle block) so its malicious payload ran every cycle, and infected OB35 (watchdog/interrupt block) to suppress error reporting. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.
